SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEP_SEQ FROM KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC WHERE DOC_TYPE = 'INV' AND BUYER IN ('CNCHSG000x') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, KEY_NO, KEY_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT f_split(data01,'^',2) AS PLANT , key_no as LEGACY_IV_NO , key_seq as LEGACY_IV_SEQ , f_split(data01,'^',2) as STATUS , f_split(data01,'^',3) AS LEGACY_PO_NO , f_split(data01,'^',4) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , f_split(data01,'^',1) AS LEGACY_PO_COUNT , f_split(data01,'^',5) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , f_split(data01,'^',6) AS ITEM_QTY , f_split(data01,'^',7) AS INV_DATE FROM KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
UPDATE KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
UPDATE KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
